name: Snyk
description: Snyk describes itself as "the AI Security Fabric" — an independent security layer that continuously validates AI-generated code, governs development agents, and secures applications across the software development lifecycle.
best_for: Targets development teams using AI coding assistants, security/DevOps teams managing application security, and enterprises scaling AI adoption who need to secure agentic development workflows.
features: Snyk Code — static application security scanning
Snyk Open Source — dependency vulnerability management
Snyk API and Web (DAST) — dynamic application/API testing
AI agent governance and AI inventory tracking

alternatives.name: Cloudflare
alternatives.description: Offers network/application-layer security (WAF, DDoS, bot management) rather than source-code/SDLC scanning.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting perimeter and runtime web application protection.

alternatives.name: Okta
alternatives.description: Secures workforce and customer identity via SSO, MFA, and governance rather than code security.
alternatives.best_for: Enterprises needing centralized identity/access control as part of their security stack.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 5 projects and 100 Snyk Code (SAST) tests per month, with SCA, SAST, IaC, and Container access.

tiers.name: Team
tiers.notes: Starts at $25/month for teams of up to 10 developers; 100 projects and 1,000 Snyk Code tests per month.

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Credit-based platform subscription; contact sales for pricing.

cons: The Free plan is limited to 5 projects and 100 Snyk Code tests per month.
The Team plan is designed for teams of up to 10 developers and is capped at 100 projects and 1,000 Snyk Code tests per month.
Snyk Evo capabilities such as AI Pentesting and Coding Agent security require an Enterprise Platform Subscription rather than Free or Team.
